result.summary: The current system log retention period is 7 days. The customer has proposed increasing it to 30 days. Engineering estimates that the change would require approximately one additional day of work on the Storage configuration if approved. The change has not yet been approved.

evidence: 고객은 보관 기간을 30일로 늘리는 방안을 제안했습니다.

schedule_impacts.description: Engineering estimates that the change would require approximately one additional day of work on the Storage configuration if approved.
schedule_impacts.duration_change: approximately one additional day of work
evidence: Engineering은 변경 시 Storage 설정 작업에 약 하루가 추가로 필요하다고 설명했습니다.

uncertainties.item: Approval of log retention period change
uncertainties.reason: The change has not yet been approved.
uncertainties.needed_information: Approval status of the proposed change.
